user.title: Add a Godox Mesh Light
user.description: All of these values come from your own nRF Mesh provisioning of this light. See the README for exactly where to find each one.

reconfigure.title: Edit Godox Mesh Light
reconfigure.description: Review or correct this light's MAC address, keys, addresses, and model. Changes are saved and applied immediately.

error.invalid_mac: That doesn't look like a valid MAC address (expected format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF)
error.invalid_key: Keys must be exactly 32 hex characters (16 bytes)
error.invalid_address: Address must be a valid mesh unicast address (1-32767), e.g. 0x0002
error.duplicate_mac: This MAC address is already used by another configured light
